# NeuromorphicObserverLoop

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A closed-loop architecture where a spiking neural network acts as an observer, estimating system states and disturbances from output measurements. Bridges control theory and neuromorphic computing, allowing TCC to implement distributed state estimation directly on network elements.
